faq.a3: Yes. Analysis and rules run on the camera. Internet is only needed to download models or updates.
faq.a4: DetectNode is an ACAP application for Axis cameras with ARTPEC-8 or ARTPEC-9, running AXIS OS 12.10 – 13.x.
faq.a5: Yes. ONNX on the CPU or TFLite on the DLPU. Detection, segmentation and anomaly models are supported.
faq.a6: A .detectnode package signed with a private key. A public key baked into the app verifies it on upload, and a green badge confirms it.
faq.a8: No. Models are not included with the app, but you'll find a link in the app to try some models.
faq.a9: No. It is a personal project in active development, provided as a trial pre-release. It is not industrial or production-ready, and comes with no warranty.

hero.eyebrow: Privacy-first edge AI for Axis cameras
hero.lead: DetectNode is an ACAP application that runs your computer vision models on your Axis camera, so the analysis stays local. You choose what DetectNode sends: measurements, events or images.
hero.lead2: No cloud account or extra server costs.
how.lead: Everything is configured from the camera's web interface. No code to write. You can add multiple analyses.

how.step2.title: Draw what to watch
how.step3.desc: Choose when to alert, then send the event or measurements to MQTT, HTTP, an Axis event or the SD card.
